name: HOLIDAY INN EXPRESS HOTEL AND SUITES

violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. Facility does not have a certified food manager. All licensed food establishments must have a certified food manager. Second inspection without a certified manager.

Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. Probe thermometer was not available during inspection. Probe thermometer should be available for checking internal temperature of foods before serving.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Wall behind the freezer, near the oven, was found dirty. Walls should be cleaned and maintained clean.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Flooring in the doorway between the kitchen and dining area was found broken/missing. Floors should be maintained in good repair.

Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. Certified food manager left facility about 8 months ago and has not been replaced. Facility must have a certified food manager in place as soon as possible.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Container with utensils under the oven was found with debris. Utensils should be stored in a clean location.
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
Properly designed, located, constructed, operated, maintained, cleaned and chemical test kit provided (2 pts deducted)
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
